counting_rule: wc-style tokens; 31 front-matter words are allocated to chapter 1 so current chapter totals equal the complete manuscript count
expansion_policy: Add scenes, reversals, consequences, relationship movement and setting evidence; do not pad existing paragraphs.
Preserve every chapter's current entry and exit turn unless the structural audit explicitly requires a causal bridge.
Reconcile progression and Supply accounting before prose that depends on those values.
Keep System notices sparse and earn every numerical change through action.

optional_psychologist_commentary_device.word_budget_rule: Commentary replaces words inside the existing 84600-word target; it does not increase the target.
adoption_tests: adds an inference the preceding scenes do not already state
does not diagnose characters or present clinical advice
does not reveal future survival or plot outcomes
